notes.title: Update 1.2.5
notes.content:
Implemented gamepad support. 
Adjust the sensitivity of the camera.
Tweaked the jerky animation of the MECh.
I took breaks between waves of mobs.
I've been working on the impact shots.
Improved the visual effects.
Added a dynamic weather change.
There are also minor improvements to the game.

notes.title: 🔥🌟 Early release of the game "Try to Survive Today" on Steam! 🌟🔥
notes.content:
I am pleased to inform you about the release of an early version of the long-awaited game "Try to Survive Today" on Steam! Today, January 14th, you will be able to immerse yourself in the exciting world of survival, where every decision you make matters. Are you ready to test your survival skills and instincts?

Try to survive Today is not just another shooter. This is an unforgettable survival experience, a unique opportunity to test your skills and instincts for strength. Crazy adventures and hordes of undead are waiting for you. 🧟‍

Join my game and test your strength in the fight for survival! I am waiting for your feedback and suggestions, as your support and ideas will help me make the game even better.

💬 Don't miss the chance! Log in to Steam, download the game and share your impressions. It's time to show what you can do! 💪🎉

notes.title: Try to survive Today on Steam Next Fest!
notes.content: I am waiting for your feedback about the demo on Steam NextFest!

notes.title: I am ready to release a DEMO version of the game Try to survive Today. And you?
notes.content:
🔹 Main features of the DEMO version:
- A fascinating story that will make you participate in exciting events.
- A variety of tasks and missions to test your survival skills.
- The opportunity to explore dangerous territories and fight against sinister enemies.
- A character development system and weapon upgrades to increase your chances of survival.
- Two modes: "MECH Warrior" and "MECH Pilot".
